capture_environment: Hosted Linux according to lead assignment; exact source/campaign binding to be attached after unmask.

meanings.physical_distinction: Estimated immediate distinction of physical shelves/supports from decoration
meanings.actor_visibility: Visible body/label against surroundings at this overview
meanings.architectural_detail: Recognizability and fine construction detail remaining in rear structures
meanings.spatial_depth: Impression of depth separation from a single still
meanings.artifact_freedom: No distracting visible blur/halo/clipping/displacement; not a correctness proof

limitations: Profile names/key were not opened before saving these scores.
Reviewer implemented renderer and previously inspected original Strata002 corpus; this is label-blind expert judgment, not a naive human study.
One paused overview, one scene, one small actor; no motion, close zoom, input/collision task or owner display examined.
Ordinal estimates have roughly one-point uncertainty; equal scores intentionally retain ties.
Scores cannot prove human route understanding or establish native authority; parent native qualification is separate.

frames.notes: Clear foreground crispness, but rear wheel and lattice lose microtexture. Softness supplies depth; some thin machinery reads as broad softened strokes.

Strongest foreground dominance among inspected frames; rear wheel and machinery remain identifiable but are noticeably dim. The small labelled actor separates slightly better; fine detail requires more effort.

Distinct restrained violet rear atmosphere while fine spokes, grilles and trusses remain readable. Physical shelves remain dominant. Strongest atmospheric/detail balance in this scene for this reviewer.

Very crisp and richly coloured rear machinery; copper rear truss and structural frames still compete with physical architecture. Beautiful construction detail, less immediate physical/decorative distinction.
Crisp cool rear architecture with moderately reduced prominence. Fine structure survives; difference from frames10/11 is too small here to rank confidently.

Warm subdued machinery and intact fine detail. Physical shelves remain clear, but rear frames still read somewhat as parallel physical structures. Small difference from08 should not be overinterpreted.

Strong physical hierarchy without heavy blur; the central wheel and rear truss remain identifiable. Restrained rear colour and luminance help the genuinely physical copper pipe stand apart. Preferred clarity/detail compromise.
Warm crisp rear machinery with visible wheel construction. Rear frame brightness competes slightly with foreground supports, though major Play shelves remain evident. Similar practical result to06.

Restrained optical softness in wheel and distant towers while machinery panels remain readable. More convincing lens separation than crisp neutral variants, with some fine texture loss. Better detail balance than01.
Crisp cool-neutral architecture; Play shelves are clear but rear frames and trusses remain a potentially ambiguous secondary structure. No confident ranking versus05/11 from this overview alone.

Neutral restrained rear presentation, strong preservation of construction detail. Spatial layering relies mainly on intensity hierarchy. Similar to05/10 at this view; no visible alpha defect observed.
